endpoint.description: Generate or edit an image with Turbo8 (8 steps, cfg 1). With no input images this is text-to-image; with one to ten input images it is image editing, and the prompt may refer to them as <image1>…<image10>. The transparency toggle wraps the prompt in the model's RGBA template.

code_snippets.python:
from gradio_client import Client, handle_file

client = Client("hugging-apps/turbo8-qwen-image-2-1")
result = client.predict(
	prompt="Hello!!",
	input_images=[],
	transparent=False,
	seed=0,
	resolution="1024",
	aspect_ratio="Auto",
	api_name="/generate",
)
print(result)
code_snippets.bash:
FILE_PATH=$(curl -s -X POST https://hugging-apps-turbo8-qwen-image-2-1.hf.space/gradio_api/upload -F 'files=@/path/to/your/file' | tr -d '[]" ')

curl -X POST https://hugging-apps-turbo8-qwen-image-2-1.hf.space/gradio_api/call/v2/generate -s -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt": "Hello!!", "input_images": {"path": "'$FILE_PATH'", "meta": {"_type": "gradio.FileData"}}, "transparent": false, "seed": 0, "resolution": "1024", "aspect_ratio": "Auto"}' \
  | awk -F'"' '{ print $4}' \
  | read EVENT_ID; curl -N https://hugging-apps-turbo8-qwen-image-2-1.hf.space/gradio_api/call/generate/$EVENT_ID
